title: CVE-2026-112302 is a path traversal vulnerability in the ZIP extraction function of the kiwilan php-archive PHP library. Versions up to 2.3.
content_md:
CVE-2026-112302 is a path traversal vulnerability in the ZIP extraction function of the kiwilan php-archive PHP library. Versions up to 2.3.
